gitleaks_scope_dir: Scope: the files of the folder {root} as they are now (gitleaks dir), not the Git history.
gitleaks_scope_git: Scope: the commits of the Git history (gitleaks git), not files not yet committed.
gitleaks_condition_redact: The value of secrets comes out masked (--redact=100, fixed in the command; no configuration file switches it off).
gitleaks_limitation_exceptions: The project's ignore file and gitleaks:allow comments are scanner exceptions, not gate waivers.
gitleaks_one_scope: One Gitleaks instance does a single scope ({first}); declare another instance for {capability}.
trivy_condition_database: Uses the vulnerability database cached in the data folder while it is within the next-update date (the run adds --skip-db-update); otherwise downloads the database (network) and caches it. The source and the dates are recorded in the result.
trivy_limitation_download: The checks bundle (misconfig) and the Java database are still downloaded on every run; only the vulnerability database has a shared cache (data folder, tools/cache/trivy-db).
trivy_limitation_exceptions: The project's ignore file is a scanner exception, not a gate waiver.
osv_condition_config_flag: The chosen osv-scanner.toml goes with --config and applies to all lockfiles.
osv_condition_per_directory: With no chosen file, OSV-Scanner reads the osv-scanner.toml next to each lockfile, with no inheritance between folders.
osv_condition_online: Online mode: queries the osv.dev API (network).
osv_limitation_no_date: The osv.dev API does not report the database date; the result records only the source.
checkov_limitation_severity: Without Prisma Cloud data there is no severity: every failing check comes out as MEDIUM.
checkov_limitation_exceptions: The checkov:skip comments in the code are scanner exceptions, not gate waivers.
security_capability_unsupported: {tool} does not do {capability} (it does {supported}): the instance runs, but does not cover that capability.
security_binding_refused: The file {binding} of the instance {tool} was refused ({file}). Fix the path in .jgates/tools.yml.
security_binding_missing: The file {binding} of the instance {tool} does not exist ({file}). Create the file or fix the path in .jgates/tools.yml.
security_binding_not_file: The {binding} of the instance {tool} points to a folder ({file}); it must be a file.
security_container_only: {tool} runs only in the container runner in this version (tools.yml asks for runner: {runner}). Remove the runner or use runner: container.
security_runtime_missing: The container runtime {runtime} was not found, and {tool} runs only in a container. Install Docker or point JGATES_CONTAINER_RUNTIME to it.
security_image_unprepared: The image of {tool} ({instance}) has not been prepared yet: run {command}. The preparation writes the image by digest and the {tool} version to .jgates/lock.json (the default image is the sidecar's).
security_lock_invalid: .jgates/lock.json is not valid ({detail}), and the image of {tool} comes only from it. Fix or delete the file and run {command}.
security_image_missing: The image {image} pinned in .jgates/lock.json for {instance} is not in the container runtime ({detail}). Run {command} again.
security_image_changed: The image {image} no longer states the {tool} version pinned in .jgates/lock.json ({detail}). Run {command} again.
security_parser_version_plan: The {tool} parser does not know version {version} (accepts {range}).
security_parser_version_report: The report was written by {tool} {version}, outside the range the parser knows ({range}).
security_document_native: File {binding}: {file} (found where the tool looks by itself).
security_document_none: File {binding}: none; the tool version default applies.
security_condition_container: Runs in a container: image {image}, workspace read-only at /workspace, output at /output, network {network}.
security_no_invocation: The plan has no invocation of the instance {tool}.
security_no_container: the plan does not carry the instance container
security_timeout: {tool} exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
security_runtime_failed: The container runtime failed to run {tool} (code {code}): {detail}
security_report_missing: {tool} did not leave the JSON report ({detail}).
security_report_too_large: The {tool} report has {bytes} bytes, above the read limit (JGATES_MAX_LOG_BYTES): treated as truncated.
security_invalid_report: The {tool} report could not be interpreted: {detail}
bridge_superseded: Switched off so the same tool does not run twice: the dedicated adapter runs {subcheck} for {capability} ({by}), and the bridge subcheck stays out.
bridge_runs_twice: The bridge subcheck {subcheck} keeps running for {capabilities}, while the dedicated adapter ({by}) runs the same tool for another capability: the tool runs twice. Declare those capabilities in the adapter instance too so the bridge leaves it out.
security_findings_dropped: {count} finding(s) of a capability the plan did not ask of this instance were left out
security_database_undated: vulnerability database {source} (the tool does not report the date)
security_database_cached: read from the cached copy in the data folder, downloaded on {date} (no new download)
security_database_stored: downloaded in this run and cached in the data folder for the next ones
bridge_linter_twice: ESLint runs twice on purpose: directly ({by}), with the project's eslint.config, and inside the bridge's MegaLinter, with the trusted config and --no-inline-config (the same as governed mode). The two results may diverge; MegaLinter does not leave ESLint out separately.
